output.notes: Described the dense Qwen2 architecture with block_ops instantiated for the smallest config (0.5B). Embedding tying is per config: true for 0.5B and 1.5B, false for 7B, 72B and 57B-A14B. For 57B-A14B, d_ff is the per-expert intermediate size; its MoE structure is listed under mechanisms. Context length 32768 is the final pre-training length; YARN+DCA extend it to 131072. RoPE theta 1000000 is the final value; it was 10000 before long-context training. Left not_stated: norm eps, RoPE pairing and fraction, the o-projection and MLP biases, attention scale, and the q/k/v output widths (only derivable as heads x head_dim). The paper does not mention a final norm before the LM head, so none is included.
